'''Club Deportivo Leganés, S.A.D.''' is a professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Leganés]], [[Community of Madrid]]. They currently compete in {{Spanish football updater|Leganés}}. Leganés was officially founded 23 June 1928 and played their first season in the 6th division of Spanish football. The club's stadium, the [[Estadio Municipal de Butarque|Estadio Municipal Butarque]], was built in 1998, after moving from the Luis Rodríguez de Miguel, a stadium they had played in since 1966.

Leganés holds home games at the [[Estadio Municipal de Butarque]], which seats 14,500 spectators."}}
